records.DESCRIPTION:
ABS Outstanding : The Owner’s Representative contacted the ABS Global Operations Center (GOC) to report that three ventilation fans were experiencing overload alarms. The affected fans are:
- No.2 C/H (S) No.4 Exhaust Fan
- No.5 C/H (S) No.3 Exhaust Fan
- Under Deck Passage (S) No.5 Supply Fan
According to the vessel, the affected fans are capable of running; however, overload alarms are triggered when the fans are stopped. The vessel further confirmed that other ventilation fans, including associated motors and ventilation arrangements serving the affected cargo holds and under deck passage spaces, remain operational. The Owner reported that spare motors have been requested and a work order has been raised for permanent repair at a suitable port in Asia, with repairs expected during the vessel's trading schedule in November 2026.
As authorized by the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA), the undersigned Surveyor carried out the attendance remotely in accordance with the provisions of MPA Shipping Circular No. 10 of 2025 dated 24 November 2025.
The following documentation and conditions were provided by the vessel and reviewed to the satisfaction of the attending Surveyor:
- Application for dispensation submitted to MPA through ABS.
- Statement of Facts dated 05 October 2026 confirming the condition of the affected fans and vessel arrangements.
- Risk Assessment identifying potential hazards associated with reduced cargo hold ventilation and detailing mitigating measures to maintain risk at an acceptable level.
- Representative photographs evidencing the overload alarms affecting the subject ventilation fans.
- Confirmation that alternative ventilation arrangements serving the affected spaces remain available and operational.
- Repair plan and confirmation that replacement motors have been requested and arrangements made for permanent rectification at a future port call.
- Review of the vessel's Cargo Ship Safety Construction Certificate and Document of Compliance for Ships Carrying Dangerous Goods.
- Master Attestation to confirm current conditions 
Based on the submitted documentary evidence and the risk control measures implemented by the vessel, the attending Surveyor is without objection to the issuance of a statutory condition valid until 06 December 2026, pending permanent rectification of the affected cargo hold ventilation fans.
